notes: «وَ سَأَلَ حَمَّادُ بْنُ عِيسَى أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ» — the asker is a link, then the Imam asked (rule 5; owner ruling 2)
the answer relays the father and then Ali in the words («قَالَ أَبِي»، «قَالَ عَلِيٌّ»): both are Imams named only in the words; Ali is the last link, the one whose words the report gives (rule 6)
the three Imams are written as the text names them; «عليه السلام» is removed
